# Class Of Learners (CoL)
> Class Of Learners is an independent, student-founded software engineering studio based in Mumbai, India (est. 2024). Built by three co-founders and three student contributors, the studio creates free, local-first, privacy-preserving interactive learning applications, 3D physics simulations, and AI utilities with zero ads or paywalls.

## Core Facts
- **Location**: Mumbai, Maharashtra, India
- **Founded**: 2024
- **Team**: 3 co-founders (Neel Badri, Aarush Vangari, Ansh Patil) and 3 contributors
- **Projects and apps**: 16
- **Indexable pages**: 19
- **Pricing & Privacy**: 100% free, offline-capable, on-device processing with zero third-party ad trackers.
- **Website**: https://advancedlogiclabs.dpdns.org/

## Flagship & Production Applications
- [Advanced Typing Instructor 1.4](https://advancedlogiclabs.dpdns.org/ati): Touch-typing and developer syntax tutor (Python, C++, JS) with 200+ levels, real-time error heatmaps, and mechanical switch audio.
- [Solar System Engine V3.3](https://advancedlogiclabs.dpdns.org/solar): 64-bit desktop Keplerian orbital mechanics simulator with real-time telemetry.
- [Perceptus Flow](https://advancedlogiclabs.dpdns.org/gesture): 60 FPS webcam-based spatial hand-tracking co-pilot using MediaPipe (21 skeletal joints).
- [Mumbai Traffic Driving Academy](https://advancedlogiclabs.dpdns.org/Traffic/Driving): 3D WebGL driving simulator modeled on Mumbai intersections, traffic signals, and RTO maneuvers — 57 levels.
- [Mumbai Traffic Rules Academy](https://advancedlogiclabs.dpdns.org/Traffic/Academy): 57-level road-safety syllabus with quizzes, progress tracking, and certificates.
- [Terra3D World Atlas](https://advancedlogiclabs.dpdns.org/Terra3D/): Interactive 3D WebGL Earth globe covering 178 countries with Rayleigh atmospheric shaders.
- [The Career Compass](https://advancedlogiclabs.dpdns.org/Career): 8-dimensional psychometric career guidance tool mapping 441 Indian and global career paths and 6,400+ job titles.
- [CivicLogic](https://advancedlogiclabs.dpdns.org/civiclogic): 50-module civic engineering knowledge base with Motor Vehicles Act jurisprudence and an RTO challan calculator.
- [Database Logic & Query Engine](https://advancedlogiclabs.dpdns.org/Database_Logic): 50-module interactive relational database and Indian Motor Vehicles Act (MVA 2019) simulator.
- [Cereal AI Assistant](https://advancedlogiclabs.dpdns.org/cereal): Native Android lecture transcription and task extraction app powered by Gemini 2.5 Flash.
- [CastFlow Studio](https://advancedlogiclabs.dpdns.org/CastFlow): Low-latency wireless screen mirroring and desktop casting over local Wi-Fi via WebRTC/DLNA.
- [QR Studio Matrix](https://advancedlogiclabs.dpdns.org/qr-editor): Vector SVG QR code generator with custom dot matrices and scan analytics.
- [Quest Master RPG](https://advancedlogiclabs.dpdns.org/rpg): 2D HTML5 Canvas retro dungeon crawler with procedural floors and WebAudio chiptune synthesis.
